behavior.arguments: rdi = base pointer. The window stores rdi+0x10 into [rdi], zeroes the qword field [rdi+8], zeroes the byte at [rdi+0x10], and returns rdi.

edges.high_address: base 0x7f0000000000 -> head store 0x7f0000000010, link qword 0, link byte 0, return 0x7f0000000000.
edges.low_address: base 0x1000 -> head store 0x1010, link qword 0, link byte 0, return 0x1000.
edges.self_pointer: the head store always points at the node's own +0x10 slot, never at another node; the stored value is derived from rdi alone.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; no branches, no calls: endbr64; lea 0x10(%rdi),%rdx; movq $0x0,0x8(%rdi); mov %rdi,%rax; mov %rdx,(%rdi); movb $0x0,0x10(%rdi); ret.
behavior.return_rule: rax is set to rdi before the return, so the returned value is exactly the base pointer on every path; there is only one path.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Sixty-six R_X86_64_RELATIVE records in .rela.dyn name this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries). They are reported as a slot list only; no meaning is claimed for the table they belong to.
